in_sanskrit.name: Dalim
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है God of the forest
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Dalim एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Dalim is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Dala' which means forest. The name is believed to be associated with the Hindu god 'Dalip,' who is the protector and ruler of forests. In Hindu mythology, Dalip is known to be a powerful and benevolent deity who is revered by the forest dwellers and is often invoked for protection and prosperity.
